newsitem.title: UK: Cinven borrows 70 mln stg for Hanson buy.
newsitem.headline: Cinven borrows 70 mln stg for Hanson buy.

text.p: LONDON, April 15 (LPC) - Venture capital group Cinven has taken a 70 million stg syndicated loan to part-fund its 135 million stg management- backed acquisition of Hanson Electrical from Hanson plc, according to a Cinven official.
The seven-year senior debt credit, which has been fully underwritten by Royal Bank of Scotland and Union Bank of Switzerland, carries a margin of 200 bps over LIBOR.
The credit will be syndicated shortly.

Cinven will pay Hanson 125 million stg in cash and the balance will be issued in loan notes which bear interest of 5 per cent and are repayable in 2006. In addition, Cinven will assume 10 million stg of further commitments to Hanson to complete the sale.
Hanson Electrical, a leading producer of electrical installation products, will be renamed Electrium following the sale.
